links.outcome: GPT-4 exam-style MCQ score versus performance on oral board clinical scenarios
links.effect: MCQs: 197/250 (78.8%) correct, 92% probability of passing ABS QE; oral boards: critical failures in 3 of 4 (75%) cases, mainly incorrect timing of intervention and incorrect operation.
links.quote: While GPT-4's high performance on MCQs mirrored prior studies, the model struggled to generate accurate long-form content in our mock oral board examination.

screen.reason: Evaluates GPT-4 on written multiple-choice and mock oral surgical board examination questions to assess clinical knowledge and decision-making accuracy.
